articles.author: PDS Biotechnology Corp
articles.headline: PDS Biotech Announces up to $22.55 Million Financing Led by Dr. Patrick Soon-Shiong, Founder of NantWorks
articles.summary: PDS announced a PIPE of up to$22.55 million led by Nant Capital, with an expected initial closing and a separate conditional milestone closing; Patrick Soon-Shiong was expected to join its board. The full amount was not already received.
articles.timestampEvidence: Finviz September 8 08:30; StockTitan full release confirms 08:30 AM EDT.
